release_notes: V47-8 (478): full stress campaign on Huawei live LTE and Xiaomi Wi-Fi. Found+fixed the rapid-reconnect half-connected defect: dnsObservationStarted was a process-scoped one-shot bit that teardown never reset, so 300ms flapping left the VPN connected with dns_relay absent and zero traffic; fix adds session-scoped DnsRelayArmPolicy (reuse/stale-bit rearm/start), per-session DNS epoch, connect-completion ensureDnsRelayArmedAfterBringup with 3 bounded attempts and session_not_ready repair, plus DnsRelayFlapRearmTest (5). NEW OPEN LAYER-2: after the flap the session is up and relay armed but DoH 8.8.8.8:443 tcp=down so traffic is still absent (evidence postfix-flap-fg.txt) -> target 0.1.47.9. Campaign on 0.1.47.7/478: Huawei LTE 13/15 scenarios pass (2 false-positive FAILs are Chrome sandbox deaths, CRASH_TOTAL=0), 3/3 LTE<->Wi-Fi switches with traffic each leg, airplane auto-recovery 2.6s, interrupt-under-load egress_after=467, YouTube/Telegram/Instagram render, kill-restore 511ms, long session 4/4; 478 multi-arm LTE decisions=65 egress 254 direct + 154 KZ, leak=0, max_tier 1/2/3=18/36/29. Canon V3 compliance matrix: only Yandex Cloud CDN whitelist contour DEFERRED (INV-16) as owner requested; 3 OPEN (INV-06 PQC/E4004, INV-14 crash-loop, INV-29 anti-clone). Tests runtime 1587/0, architecture 122/0, gates 12/12.
